paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 这篇论文提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，揭示了结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的深层联系，并通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁将二者统一起来 [S1.p2][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的 SSD 算法，通过半可分矩阵的分块分解同时利用线性递归和二次对偶形式，在训练和推理效率上取得更优权衡 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.p4]。作者进一步设计了 Mamba-2 架构，其核心层是 Mamba 选择性 SSM 的改进版本，速度提升 2-8 倍，同时在语言建模上保持竞争力 [abstract][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。实验表明，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++，并在标准下游评测中匹配或超越同规模开源 Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3][S9.F9]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法和系统优化迁移到 SSM，以构建性能更好且随序列长度扩展更高效的基础模型 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的集体努力显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像 Transformer 那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it is more difficult to understand and experiment with SSMs compared to Transformers

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）这一抽象，建立 SSM 与注意力变体之间的联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，并将 SSM 的不同计算方式重新表述为结构化矩阵上的各种矩阵乘法算法 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在此基础上，作者提出基于半可分矩阵分块分解的 SSD 算法，同时利用线性 SSM 递归和二次对偶形式，在训练和推理计算、内存使用以及利用现代硬件矩阵乘法单元的能力等主要效率轴上取得最优权衡 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
We show an equivalence between state space models and a well-studied family of structured matrices called semiseparable matrices
different methods of computing state space models can be reframed as various matrix multiplication algorithms on structured matrices
We introduce a new SSD algorithm, based on block decompositions of semiseparable matrices, that takes advantage of both the linear SSM recurrence and quadratic dual form
obtaining optimal tradeoffs on all main efficiency axes

experiments.text: 论文在合成联想回忆任务（多查询联想回忆 MQAR）上评估 Mamba-2，该任务对循环模型具有挑战性 [S9.p1][S9.SS1.p1]。在语言建模方面，作者在 Pile 数据集上训练从约 125M 到 2.7B 参数的模型，遵循 GPT3 规格和 Chinchilla 协议，并与 Mamba、Transformer++ 及 Pythia 等开源模型比较 [S9.SS2.p1][S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。作者还进行了速度基准测试，将 SSD 算法与 Mamba 的扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 对比 [S9.SS3.p1]。此外，作者消融了 Mamba-2 架构的多种设计选择，包括块设计、多头结构和注意力核近似 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

We use the Pile dataset, and follow the training recipe described in.
Figure 9 shows scaling laws under the standard Chinchilla protocol, on models from $\approx 125M$ to $\approx 1.3B$ parameters.
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block

findings.text: SSD 算法比 Mamba 优化的选择性扫描实现快 2-8 倍，同时允许更大的循环状态尺寸，并在序列长度 2K 处与 FlashAttention-2 交叉、在 16K 处快 6 倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，即使在控制状态尺寸（N=16）时也显著优于 Mamba-1，且增大状态尺寸持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。在语言建模上，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]；例如 2.7B 参数、在 Pile 上训练 300B token 的 Mamba-2 优于 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。消融实验发现，多值注意力（MVA）头模式表现最佳，而所尝试的核近似方法未能超过简单的逐点非线性激活函数 [S9.SS4.SSS2.p3][S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: A dedicated implementation of SSD is $2-8\times$ faster than the optimized selective scan implementation of Mamba
crossing over at sequence length 2K and 6 $\times$ faster at sequence length 16K
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ($\mathtt{N}=16$)
increasing from $\mathtt{N}=16$ to $\mathtt{N}=64$ and $\mathtt{N}=256$ consistently improves performance on MQAR
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B
We empirically find that the MVA pattern as originally used in Mamba performs best.
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions for $\psi$

limitations.text: 作者指出，SSD 相比此前结构化 SSM 的主要限制在于状态转移 $A_t$ 的表达能力，SSD 仅使用更受限的对角线形式，以表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者还指出，Mamba-2 整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层而 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。此外，作者强调 SSD 并未泛化标准 softmax 注意力，且 Mamba-2 在部分能力上虽显著改进但仍有待进一步理解 [S10.SS3.p8]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length
SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention
Mamba-2 significantly improves on Mamba on some of these capabilities
but more remains to be understood
